execution: decide at close, fill at next open, long-only, no leverage
hypothesis: Buying BTC at 21:00 UTC and selling at 23:00 UTC showed 33-41% a year gross in practitioner studies (no costs, contested by a seven-exchange study). Unconditionally it cannot pay 20 bps round trip, so it is traded only on days when the window's own trailing mean return already exceeds the 30 bps cost hurdle and the daily trend is up.
rules: Hourly bars. Window return for a UTC date = open of 23:00 / open of 21:00 - 1.

At the close of the 20:00 bar of date d trade only if BOTH hold: (a) the mean window return over the previous 60 dates >= 30 bps; (b) the daily close (23:00 bar close) of date d-1 is above the SMA(50) of daily closes.
If so hold the asset for the bars opening at 21:00 and 22:00 (exit at the 23:00 open), weight 1/3 per asset.
Decide at the bar close, fill at the next bar open, long-only, no leverage.
